title: Smoky Poblano Corn Pudding
description: At your next holiday gathering, try this corn poblano casserole made with frozen corn, cream, Cheddar cheese, poblano peppers, and eggs.
ingredients: 1 tablespoon chopped fresh chives, or to taste

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees F (200 degrees C). Place poblano peppers on a baking sheet.
Roast peppers in the preheated oven until slumped and charred, about 30 minutes. Remove from the oven and let cool slightly. Reduce the oven temperature to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
Remove stems, seeds, and charred skin from peppers; roughly chop flesh.
Whisk milk, cream, sugar, flour, melted butter, eggs, and salt together in a bowl. Stir in corn, Cheddar cheese, and chopped poblanos. Pour mixture into the prepared baking dish.
Bake in the oven until set, slightly puffed on top, and golden around the edges, 45 minutes to 1 hour. Garnish with chopped chives.

video.description: Welcome some warming comfort to your table, especially when it’s chilly outside or you have guests gathered around . . . this delicious corn side dish is a crowd pleaser and elevates everyone’s favorite sweet veggie to a flavor that’s extra special. Combine milk, cream, eggs, sugar, flour, butter and salt with corn, Cheddar cheese and roasted poblano peppers and bake and serve topped with chives. You won’t have much time to admire your handiwork, because this hot dish disappears quickly!
